title: Waiver of examinations.
officialText:
Any license issued without examination pursuant to an application filed prior to July 25, 1990
pursuant to the provisions of law in effect prior to July 1, 2008 that has not lapsed as of July 1, 2008, shall be renewable pursuant to
the provisions of this code.
